description.value: Phonomenal Vietnamese Café is an authentic pho restaurant that has been serving Greater Victoria since November 2011, located in Shelbourne Village Square at the intersection of Cedar Hill Cross Rd. and Shelbourne St. The menu spans appetizers, large-format pho, grilled sandwiches, rice dishes, and vermicelli, with a signature 'jumble size' pho that the kitchen describes as a standout. Its location within walking distance of the University of Victoria and near Camosun College makes it a natural refuelling stop along the Shelbourne corridor.
